newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies 13 bond issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies 13 bond issues for insurance.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp said Monday it qualified for insurance 13 bond issues slated for for competitive sale on Monday.
--Pine Bluff School District #3, Ariz., $4.5 million of refunding and construction bonds.
--Des Moines, Iowa, $36 million and $16 million of general obligation (GO) bonds.
--Ventura Community School District, Iowa, $1.9 million of GO school bonds.
--Rich Township High School District, Ill., $14 million of GO and refunding bonds.
--Hartland District, Mich., $19 million of school district bonds.
--Hibbing, Minn., $5.3 million of GO public utility revenue refunding bonds.
--South St. Paul, Minn., $5 million of GO tax increment bonds.
--St. Louis Park, Minn., $9.5 million of GO tax increment bonds.
--Greenville Area School District, Pa., $8 million of GO bonds under the alternate bidding program.
--West Perry School District, Pa., $6 million of GO bonds under the alternate bidding program.
--Mesquite, Texas, $5.140 million, $1.4 million and $305,000 of GOs.
--West Harris MUD No. 10, Texas, $3.970 million GOs.
--Phillips School District, Wis., $2.6 million school building bonds.
